A '''Miraluka tapestry''' was a type of tapestry. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a stolen ornately woven [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] tapestry worth 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] was taken to a hotel room in the [[Starlight Lounge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] by the minions of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Gomalo]].
